# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_PARAM_SWEEP_KEEPER_1

## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK strategy with specific parameters (vol_mult=1.3, body_min_cents=0.05, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2, premium_stop_pct=-0.08, tp1_premium_pct=0.4, runner_target_pct=1.5, profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667, qty=10, proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true) aims to capture edge from SPY 0DTE put options by entering on confirmed level breaks with volume confirmation and managing exits via a 40% TP1 scale-out and a trailing profit lock armed immediately. The edge is hypothesized to exist due to the persistence of level breaks in bearish market regimes.

## Mechanism

Enter SPY 0DTE put at strike_offset=2 (ITM-2 for bearish setups) when: volume exceeds vol_mult * 20-bar average volume, candle body size >= body_min_cents, min_stars>=2 (market structure confirmation), and proximity to the broken level <= proximity_dollars. Require the break to be above the open if require_break_above_open=true. Exit 2/3 of position at tp1_premium_pct=40% gain, trail the remaining 1/3 with profit lock armed immediately (threshold_pct=0.0) trailing at profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=5% of current premium (for puts, stop moves up as premium increases). Catastrophe premium stop at -8%. Time stop at 15:50 ET.
